text:
emma (AE): Heads-up — ArborBank POC is seeing intermittent 503s and big spikes in time-to-first-token (TTFT). They demoed and noticed a couple of slow responses (0.5–2s) and then full 503s. Legal also pushed a security questionnaire and finance is asking if we can cap POC spend. Can we swarm? Link to customer-replay: https://internal/boards/ARB-POC

marta (CS): On it. Can you drop the most recent request IDs and whether they're streaming or standard requests? Any pattern on payload size?

emma (AE): Mostly short chat-like prompts — 30–120 tokens. Non-streaming. I grabbed one request id: req_20260321_8742. Happened twice in the last 20m.

raj (SRE): Looking at infra metrics for ArborBank tenant. Observed enqueue_delay_ms spiking to ~120ms with batch_size=1 on a few hosts, then execution_ms jumping to 300–800ms before 503. Also seeing rate_limiter: token_bucket=0 for a burst window. Full line from worker logs: 

```

[worker-3] enqueue_delay_ms=125 batch_size=1 exec_ms=412 http_status=503 err="backend unavailable" route=arborbank-poc

[ratelimit] tenant=arborbank burst_remaining=0 refill_ms=60000

```

raj (SRE): My suspicion: client is doing aggressive retries on 5xx and filling the route queue -> smaller batches and worse latency (bad spiral). Need to confirm client retry logic + backoff. Also we should check batch_window_ms and max_batch_size.

oliver (Infra Eng): Agreed. For short, chatty requests we often want a smaller batch window to reduce TTFT. Current route config is batch_window_ms=25, max_batch_size=128. Try temporarily: batch_window_ms=6, max_batch_size=64. That will favour latency over peak throughput. Command I can run: 

```

redwoodctl routes update --route arborbank-poc --set batch_window_ms=6 --set max_batch_size=64

```

oliver (Infra Eng): Another angle — client-side micro-batching (combine sequential messages into a single call) or small local buffer with 10ms jitter reduces request rate. If they can't change client, we can enable a small response cache for repeated system prompts.

marta (CS): Nora — legal wants the standard security questionnaire answered for this POC (network separation, audit logs, KMS/HSM usage). Can you take it? I'll add the customer contact.

nora (Security): I’ll prep answers. Short bullets for now: VPC peering/private deployment available, control plane logs in SIEM, customer keys can be stored in KMS/HSM integrations, SOC2 & ISO statements available, per-route audit logs retained for 90d (can extend on request). Will fill the full form by EOD.

deploy-bot: route update applied to arborbank-poc by oliver. Rolling restart 4 nodes -> 0/4 ready, 2/4 ready, 4/4 ready.

raj (SRE): After bumping burst limits and oliver's route tweak, 503s dropped immediately. However TTFT still exhibits spikes at ~200–400ms for single-token requests. Metrics show many batches with size=1.

oliver (Infra Eng): That's expected if customer is hammering with sub-100ms inter-arrival without batching. Two quick tests: 1) client-side: add 8–12ms buffer + random jitter and send tiny batches of up to 4; 2) server-side: we can try adaptive_small_request_path which lowers overhead for single-token requests (config flip). I'll kick off test 2 now if approved.

emma (AE): Quick ask on pricing: can we offer a POC cap or credit? Customer wants predictable spend during the trial. What are guardrails?

marta (CS): We usually do a $5k POC credit + monitoring and an optional burst-limit agreement (so we don't absorb unlimited load). Finance needs to ok anything above $5k. I'll start the paper trail.

raj (SRE): Recommendation: while we test, enable short-term elevated burst for arborbank and monitor token consumption; if they exceed threshold, automated alerts go to @marta and @emma. Also advise client to disable aggressive retry and implement exponential backoff (recommended policy: start at 100ms, *2, max 2s).

nora (Security): Security questionnaire: sent initial draft answers to marta. Nothing blocking for POC; private deployment is an option if they require stricter isolation.

marta (CS): Running a controlled replay now with our recommended client jitter + the new route config. Will post perf dashboard (latency percentiles + batch size distribution). ETA 20m.

emma (AE): Thanks team — please keep me posted. I'll confirm the $5k credit path with finance and loop in ArborBank contacts.

oliver (Infra Eng): Follow-up note — if the controlled replay reduces single-size batches by >40% we should see median TTFT drop below 90ms. If not, we'll enable adaptive_small_request_path and run another cycle.

marta (CS): Test complete: batch_size distribution shifted to 1/3 size=1, 2/3 size=2-6. Median TTFT dropped from 210ms -> 78ms, 95th from 840ms -> 180ms. No 503s during the run. Sharing dashboard: https://internal/metrics/arborbank-poc

emma (AE): Perfect. I'll send ArborBank the summary + next steps on security + pricing. Great swarm — resolving for now, will re-open if anything else crops up.
